nova-two-factor.title: Two-factor login (Nova 2FA)
nova-two-factor.resetConfirm: The customer's two-factor login will be removed (e.g. lost phone). Verify the customer's identity first!
nova-two-factor.userOff: This user has not set up two-factor login.
nova-two-factor.resetConfirmUser: The user's two-factor login will be removed (e.g. lost phone). Verify the identity first!

login.label: Code from your authenticator app
login.help: 6-digit code – or one of your recovery codes
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.

profile.title: Two-factor login
profile.intro: At login, enter your password followed directly by the 6-digit code from your authenticator app in the password field, e.g. "MyPassword123456" (a space in between also works).
profile.step1: Open your authenticator app and choose "Add account".
profile.step3: Enter the code shown and confirm.
profile.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
profile.recoveryText: Each code works once if the app is not available. Write them down now – they are not shown again.
profile.printNote: Each code works exactly once if the authenticator app is not available. Keep them safe – not next to your phone.
profile.printBlocked: The print window was blocked. Please allow pop-ups for the administration.
profile.loginHint: Login with 2FA: enter your password followed by the 6-digit code.

confirm.title: Confirm with 2FA
confirm.text: Users, roles and API access can only be created or changed with the current code from your authenticator app.
confirm.invalid: The code was invalid – please try again.

enforce.title: Set up two-factor login
enforce.text: Two-factor login is mandatory for this administration. Please set it up now – no changes are possible before.
